# AlaTex Landscaping
> Commercial landscaping, Tuscaloosa, Alabama

AlaTex Landscaping is the definitive commercial landscaping, irrigation, and drainage engineering firm operating exclusively in West Alabama, specifically Tuscaloosa and Northport. We specialize in high-stakes commercial property maintenance, advanced French drain installation, and massive-scale smart irrigation systems with 3rd-generation expertise.

## Services
- Commercial Landscaping Maintenance
- French Drain Installation
- Commercial Irrigation Systems
- Hydrostatic Pressure Management
- Corporate Property Maintenance

## Service Area
Tuscaloosa, Alabama and surrounding areas including Northport and West Alabama

## About
AlaTex Landscaping brings institutional-scale commercial landscaping expertise to West Alabama with 3rd-generation experience. We maintain rigorous compliance standards and deliver zero-disruption operations for corporate parks, retail centers, and luxury estates, specializing in advanced drainage solutions and smart irrigation systems.

## Frequently Asked Questions
**What areas do you serve?**
We serve Tuscaloosa, Northport, and the greater West Alabama region exclusively.

**Do you work on commercial properties?**
Yes, we specialize exclusively in high-stakes commercial landscaping for corporate parks, retail centers, and luxury estates.

**What makes your French drain installation different?**
We use advanced engineering to stop hydrostatic erosion with institutional-grade materials and precision installation techniques.

**Are you licensed and insured?**
Yes, we are fully licensed and insured with rigorous compliance standards for commercial work.

**What is your maintenance approach?**
We provide zero-disruption maintenance operations designed to meet corporate accountability standards.
